text:
Sophie: Quick heads-up — Im planning a release cut for v1.12.0 in ~2h. Need: changelog linter ✅, who will GPG-sign the annotated tag, and who will attach artifacts / publish the draft. @Chris @Mike please chime in.
Jamal: Running the changelog linter now.
Mike: I can sign + push the annotated tag. Will need the Linux tarball sha256 and a green binary-builder job.
Chris: Ill handle attaching artifacts to the draft release and add a small \"highlights\" section. Ill keep it as pre-release until QA thumbs up.
Anna: FYI binary-builder job flaked last night; I kicked a rerun just now.
ci-bot: build/binary-builder #987 re-run triggered by @Anna  queued on r5-gpu
Sophie: @Jamal thanks  if you get a clean lint, pls post the PR link. @Mike Ill paste the s3 path when the artifact is available.
Jamal: Linter passed after tiny docs header tweak, PR merged: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4242
ci-bot: build/binary-builder #987 succeeded  artifact uploaded: s3://redwood-artifacts/releases/v1.12.0/redwood-server-linux-amd64.tar.gz
Mike: sha256: 3b7f9d8e2c1a4b5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f0a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9
Mike: Tagging steps I ran:
```
git tag -a v1.12.0 -m \"Release v1.12.0 - runtime & release infra fixes\"
gpg --detach-sign -a v1.12.0
git push origin v1.12.0
```
Mike: pushed annotated tag + .asc signature. @release-bot @Chris go ahead.
release-bot: Push received for v1.12.0  verifying tag signature (gpg: Good signature)
Chris: Attaching artifact + adding checksums and highlights. Draft release URL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/releases/tag/v1.12.0 (kept as pre-release)
Anna: Kicked off a quick staged smoke on staging-cluster-3; will post results in ~20m.
Linda: Small smoke so far: API readiness, model load, and basic e2e flows look OK. No obvious regressions yet.
Sophie: Awesome progress  plan is to flip to final in 1h if staging smoke stays clean. Ill prepare the announcement copy and release notes snippet. :tada: 
Chris: After QA sign-off Ill mark release final and set published timestamp. Will also ping infra for rollout notes.
Sophie: Thanks everyone — looping back in this thread with final status before publish.
